interface.shortDescription: The AI agent for paid media teams: diagnose, analyze creative, research competitors, cut waste, shift budget, launch and report across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft Ads.
interface.longDescription:
GoMarble connects Codex to your ad accounts, analytics and store data. It explains what changed and why, and prepares the next move for your approval.

• Diagnose performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft Ads, with GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo and Search Console as the business truth.
• Analyze creative (hooks, hold, fatigue, winning patterns) and research competitor ads in GoMarble's ad library.
• Write creative briefs, cut wasted spend and shift budget, with every change proposed first and applied only after you approve it.
• Launch and edit Meta and Google campaigns, build reports, and set up agents that watch your accounts on a schedule and report by email or Slack.
• 52 skills built on GoMarble's own playbooks, kept in sync with the GoMarble connector.

Free to install. Sign in with your GoMarble account (free plan available at gomarble.ai).
defaultPrompt: Why did ROAS drop on my Meta account last week?
Find wasted spend in my Google Search campaigns and propose negatives.
Break down my top Meta ads: what's winning and what's fatiguing?
Set up a daily brief across all my accounts, emailed at 9am.
